Anya: Legal requires EU-only inference+weights for EU tenants. Can we make a strict routing contract?
Tom: Confirming: no cross-region fallback, not even for warm fetches?
Anya: Correct. If EU-variant missing, reject and provide mirror-request link. Control-plane metadata ok if anonymized.
Chris: Need catalog compatibility matrix per-variant (family, quant, tokenization, compat-score). Proxy checks local cache.
Maria: Response headers: X-Model-Status=ok|compat|missing|unknown; X-Compat-Score when compat. Metric variant_missing{tenant,model,region}.
Tom: Policy draft: 1) exact tenant+region+variant, 2) region-compatible variant, 3) reject with structured error and mirror instructions. No cross-region auto-fetch.
Chris: Allow operator/CLI mirror request flow; ops validates provenance then mirrors into EU blobstore. Until then requests fail.
deploy-bot: Created INF-2389: "signed-manifest + regional-mirror-checklist"
Anya: Action items: Tom -> routing PR; Chris -> catalog schema; Maria -> headers/metrics.
Tom: Will open PR tomorrow.
Chris: LGTM.
